description: Elevate your project scheduling and visualization capabilities with the Apex Linear Schedule visual, the ultimate tool for Microsoft Power BI. This custom visual is purpose-built for linear project types like Tunnels, Railways, Roads, Pipelines, High-Rise Buildings, and more, allowing you to transform complex project schedules into easily digestible Time-Location format charts. Key Features Apex Time Location Chart offers a number of powerful features and capabilities that make it an ideal choice for project teams and stakeholders. These include but are not limited to: Edit Pane Take control of your project linear schedules with our extensive customization options. Define the shape settings and orders for each activity type and select which items to display on the chart, ensuring your project data is presented exactly the way you want it. Zoom-In, Zoom-Out and Pan: Dive deep into your project timelines or get a high-level overview with the zoom-in/out and pan capabilities. Analyze details or view the bigger picture with ease. Interaction Capability: Seamlessly integrate the Apex Time-Location Chart with other visuals, enhancing your project management and analysis. Create dynamic dashboards by linking this visual to other Power BI components. Add Custom Image & Labels: Bring your project locations to life by adding your custom image to the chart.
